tools.name: catalog
tools.description: Inspect this connection’s scope, tools and access policy. With no arguments returns the usual catalog. On the general or economy connection, optionally supply report_countries (1–10 World Bank codes) for a FREE live preview of the optional paid country comparison: population/GDP/inflation by default

tools.name: list_us_economic_indicators
tools.description: Discover three official BLS US monthly series, original units, seasonal adjustment, latest periods and freshness. Rolling ten calendar years, not a full archive. CPI is an index, payroll employment counts jobs in thousands. Read source notes.

tools.name: get_us_economic_indicators
tools.description: BLS US monthly consumer_price_index (CPI-U NSA, 1982-84=100), unemployment (SA percent civilian labor force 16+), nonfarm_employment (SA thousands of payroll jobs). Default last 12 monthly periods; limit 1-120 or exact period YYYY-MM, mutually exclusive. Retains source decimals, missing values, prel

tools.name: list_interest_rate_series
tools.description: Discover scoped official policy rates: provider=boe for UK Bank Rate daily since 1975 (historical regimes and notes preserved); fed for eight US series with distinct starts since 1982 (pre-1994 target reconstructed); ecb for three current instruments and historical minimum-bid refinancing since 1999

tools.name: get_interest_rates
tools.description: Retrieve or export central-bank policy rates in percent. provider=boe series=bank_rate since 1975; boc default overnight_target/bank_rate since 2010; ecb deposit_facility/main_refinancing/marginal_lending and historical main_refinancing_minimum_bid since 1999; fed eight series from directory with di

tools.name: list_economic_indicators
tools.description: Eurostat EU/EFTA country codes and monthly/quarterly economic series since 2020. Includes latest published periods, source definitions, units and collection status. Country codes differ from World Bank; Greece is EL.

tools.name: get_economic_indicators
tools.description: Eurostat HICP annual inflation rate (monthly), seasonally adjusted unemployment rate (monthly), or real GDP growth over the previous quarter (quarterly). EU/EFTA only, since 2020 through latest published periods. Source flags, missing cells, units and evidence retained. Use list_economic_indicators

tools.name: get_indicators
tools.description: Annual population, GDP in current US dollars and CPI inflation from World Bank WDI worldwide economies. Use list_countries for supported three-character codes. Five completed years only, not real-time. Returns units, definitions, producers, footnotes and provenance. Null is missing, never zero. Not

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List economies and territories available for annual indicators. Aggregated regions are excluded. Coverage and missing values vary by indicator.

tools.name: list_historical_indicators
tools.description: List twenty-two annual World Bank historical series, units, definitions via records, and latest collection status. Coverage starts in 1960 with missing years preserved. Not real-time.

tools.name: get_historical_indicators
tools.description: Annual historical series for one World Bank country and indicator from 1960 to the last completed year. Use list_historical_indicators for keys and list_countries for countries. Choose GDP per capita, current dollars or constant 2015 dollars explicitly; these are not interchangeable. Nulls are missi

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Get an unexpired record with provenance and its explicit verification level. Source/schema validation is not independent factual verification.

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: Retrieve the source JSON snapshot and SHA-256 digest for a currently available record. The digest proves snapshot integrity, not factual truth.
